s01_hub_public_access_path_count.formula: count(continuous_public_paths connecting the south-end hub interface, park south entrance, and adjacent street network within S01)
assumptions: S01 is an explanatory segment, not an official station-area boundary.
s01_hub_public_access_path_count.reason: Road, entrance, accessibility, and station concourse geometries have not yet been built for the new package.
s01_hub_public_access_path_count.failure_threshold: zero continuous public paths with a non-digital fallback
s01_hub_public_access_path_count.target_rule: 至少两条彼此独立的连续公共路径，且每条都有静态/人工回退。
s01_hub_public_access_path_count.target_basis: 避免枢纽接口单一路径失效。
s01_hub_public_access_path_count.target_verification: 现场步行审计+无障碍审计+人工回退演练。

measurement_protocol.collector: 交通专业团队+无障碍审查员
measurement_protocol.timing: 设计试行前、工作日高峰与夜间各1次
measurement_protocol.evidence_record: route_audit/S01/{date}.json + geotagged route track + obstruction log
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 连续公共路径数量达到 target_value，且每条有静态/人工回退
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 记录断点、障碍、开放时段和回退路径；任一关键路径失效即触发 S01 回退

s02_four_quadrant_connection_count.formula: count(accessible_path_pairs connecting the four Dazhongsi station quadrants without entering verified heritage constraints)
assumptions: Dazhongsi geometry is an anchor-corrected concept pending official key-area polygons.
s02_four_quadrant_connection_count.reason: Station exits, exact heritage polygons, and accessible path geometry are not yet available in the new package.
s02_four_quadrant_connection_count.failure_threshold: any quadrant without an accessible route to the park or station frontage
s02_four_quadrant_connection_count.target_rule: 四个站域象限均有不侵入已确认文保约束的无障碍路径。
s02_four_quadrant_connection_count.target_basis: 四象限是大钟寺原型的最低空间完整性。
s02_four_quadrant_connection_count.target_verification: 四象限逐一现场核验，任一象限失败即停止环线承诺。

measurement_protocol.collector: 交通专业团队+文保专业人员+无障碍审查员
measurement_protocol.timing: 正式重点区 polygon 和文保约束发布后，方案试行前
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 四个象限均有不侵入已确认文保约束的无障碍路径
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 按象限记录失败原因；任一象限失败则取消完整环线，回退为分段路径

s03_reversible_elevated_interface_length.formula: sum(length(public_interface_segments under or adjacent to existing elevated structures where fallback_action is defined))
assumptions: The final Line 13 upgrade section is unknown and must not be treated as approved engineering geometry.
s03_reversible_elevated_interface_length.reason: Existing elevated footprints and proposed reversible interface geometries have not yet been digitized.
s03_reversible_elevated_interface_length.failure_threshold: interface requires the unconfirmed future rail configuration to function
s03_reversible_elevated_interface_length.target_rule: 正式工程断面确认后，公共接口长度不得低于满足独立回退路径的最小长度；不得以未确认高架/入地关系预设数值。
s03_reversible_elevated_interface_length.target_basis: 工程关系 unknown，先闭合安全与回退条件，再计算长度。
s03_reversible_elevated_interface_length.target_verification: 工程断面审查+施工安全审查+回退路径核验。

measurement_protocol.collector: 轨道工程团队+结构/施工安全审查方
measurement_protocol.timing: 13号线最终工程断面和施工时序发布后、任何接口设计审批前
measurement_protocol.evidence_record: engineering_review/S03/{version}.json + approved section reference + safety sign-off
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 仅计算经工程确认且有独立回退路径的公共接口长度
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 记录断面冲突、施工影响和替代方案；未获工程确认时指标保持 null

s04_daily_access_point_count.formula: count(public_access_points connecting Zhichun Road station, park entrances, and adjacent communities within S04)
s04_daily_access_point_count.reason: Park entrance and community street connection geometries are not yet registered in the new package.
s04_daily_access_point_count.failure_threshold: no accessible route from station frontage to an open park entrance
s04_daily_access_point_count.target_rule: 至少形成站口、公园入口、相邻社区三类可进入公共接口；每类至少一处可用。
s04_daily_access_point_count.target_basis: 保证日常使用不依赖单一入口。
s04_daily_access_point_count.target_verification: 入口开放时段、无障碍、夜间照明和人工求助核验。

measurement_protocol.collector: 公园管理方+属地街道+无障碍审查员
measurement_protocol.timing: 工作日、周末、夜间各1次；季节性入口调整时重测
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 站口、公园、社区三类入口均有至少一处可用公共接口
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 记录关闭、障碍和照明问题；入口不足时撤回场景并保留静态导视

s05_dual_anchor_continuous_route_count.formula: count(continuous_public_routes linking Wudaokou anchor, Qinghuadongluxikou anchor, park interfaces, and east-side neighborhood frontage)
assumptions: The origin community is interpreted as a cross-corridor interface; this is not an official boundary determination.
s05_dual_anchor_continuous_route_count.reason: The dual-anchor route network and official key-area polygon have not yet been built.
s05_dual_anchor_continuous_route_count.failure_threshold: either official anchor is excluded from all continuous public routes
s05_dual_anchor_continuous_route_count.target_rule: 五道口与清华东路西口双锚点均接入至少两条连续公共过境路径，至少一条不依赖校园内部。
s05_dual_anchor_continuous_route_count.target_basis: 原点社区以跨廊道连续性和冗余为最低目标。
s05_dual_anchor_continuous_route_count.target_verification: 双锚点路径审计+校园权属确认+替代路径测试。

measurement_protocol.collector: 交通专业团队+校园/社区协同方+权属确认方
measurement_protocol.timing: 正式重点区 polygon、道路和校园开放边界确认后
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 两个官方锚点均接入至少两条连续公共路线，至少一条不穿受控校园
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 任一锚点或替代路线失败时拆分为三个短链，不宣布跨廊闭环

s06_memory_route_length_m.formula: projected_length(EPSG:4548, selected_public_memory_route from Old Tsinghuayuan Station to current corridor)
assumptions: S06 is a cultural interpretation route and not a surviving continuous railway alignment.
s06_memory_route_length_m.reason: Only anchor-to-anchor explanatory geometry exists; a walkable route has not yet been selected or validated.
s06_memory_route_length_m.failure_threshold: route representation falsely implies the historical railway remains continuous
s06_memory_route_length_m.target_rule: 先确认一条可步行、来源可查且不暗示历史线位连续的当代记忆路线，再按 EPSG:4548 计算长度；未确认前不设硬长度。
s06_memory_route_length_m.target_basis: 该指标是文化解释路线，不是历史铁路保有长度。
s06_memory_route_length_m.target_verification: 历史资料审校+步行路径核验+图面语义审查。

measurement_protocol.collector: 历史资料审校方+文化机构+步行交通团队
measurement_protocol.timing: 历史资料和当代步行路径审校通过后；路线改线时重测
measurement_protocol.evidence_record: heritage_route/S06/{version}.json + source quotation log + GPS route
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 路线可步行、端点可复核、每个历史断言有来源，且不暗示历史铁路连续保有
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 记录来源争议和路线断点；取消连续线位表达，保留点位导览

s07_public_frontage_length_m.formula: sum(length(building_or_site_frontages directly connected to public_space and marked as publicly accessible within S07))
assumptions: No private property is assumed to be publicly accessible without evidence.
s07_public_frontage_length_m.reason: Building frontage, ownership, and public-access attributes are not yet available.
s07_public_frontage_length_m.failure_threshold: reported public frontage includes unverified private or controlled-access space
s07_public_frontage_length_m.target_rule: 正式建筑/产权/公共开放属性确认后，至少形成一段连续、可公开进入的首层界面；数值按确认界面长度计算。
s07_public_frontage_length_m.target_basis: 不能把私有或受控空间计为公共界面。
s07_public_frontage_length_m.target_verification: 产权/开放授权+现场连续性+消防无障碍审计。

measurement_protocol.collector: 产权/权属确认方+建筑专业团队+无障碍/消防审查方
measurement_protocol.timing: 建筑轮廓、产权和公共开放授权取得后；开放条件变化时重测
measurement_protocol.evidence_record: frontage_audit/S07/{date}.json + frontage segment map + access authorization
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 只累计被确认可公开进入、连续连接公共空间的界面长度
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 剔除私有或受控界面；无法确认时指标保持 null，不用概念 frontage 替代

s08_station_park_industry_connection_cou.formula: count(continuous_public_connections linking Xuezhiyuan station, Xuebei Park frontage, and heritage park access within S08)
assumptions: Xuebei Park internal access is not presumed public beyond cited project information.
s08_station_park_industry_connection_cou.reason: Public-access entrances and park connection geometries have not yet been verified.
s08_station_park_industry_connection_cou.failure_threshold: connection relies exclusively on controlled-access park interiors
s08_station_park_industry_connection_cou.target_rule: 至少一条连续公共连接同时触达学知园站、学北园公共前场和遗址公园入口，且不依赖园区内部受控空间。
s08_station_park_industry_connection_cou.target_basis: 众智园原型的最小产业—站点—公园接口。
s08_station_park_industry_connection_cou.target_verification: 公共入口授权+现场路径核验+人工替代测试。

measurement_protocol.collector: 园区运营方+轨道站域管理方+公园管理方
measurement_protocol.timing: 园区和公园开放授权确认后，试行前和试行后各1次
measurement_protocol.evidence_record: route_audit/S08/{date}.json + three-node connection checklist + authorization record
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 至少一条连续公共连接同时触达学知园站、学北园公共前场和遗址公园入口
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 若依赖受控园区内部则不计入，回退为园区外侧接口

s09_bluegreen_public_access_point_count.formula: count(public_access_points to the Qinghe-bluegreen interface that do not enter unverified flood, blue-line, or utility constraints)
assumptions: No flood-control or official blue-line geometry is currently available.
s09_bluegreen_public_access_point_count.reason: Official water-control constraints and proposed access points have not yet been digitized.
s09_bluegreen_public_access_point_count.failure_threshold: any access point conflicts with official water-control data when released
s09_bluegreen_public_access_point_count.target_rule: 至少两个陆侧公共进入点，均避开正式蓝线、防洪和市政约束，并具备暴雨回退。
s09_bluegreen_public_access_point_count.target_basis: 蓝绿接口需有冗余且不能以临水设施替代安全条件。
s09_bluegreen_public_access_point_count.target_verification: 蓝线/防洪资料叠加+极端天气预案+现场安全审查。

measurement_protocol.collector: 水务/园林专业方+防洪安全审查方+属地街道
measurement_protocol.timing: 蓝线、防洪和市政资料发布后；汛期前后各复核1次
measurement_protocol.evidence_record: bluegreen_audit/S09/{date}.json + constraint overlay + weather fallback log
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 至少两个陆侧公共进入点均不冲突正式水务约束，且有暴雨回退
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 记录冲突点和天气条件；撤除临水设施，转为陆侧静态展示

s10_ringroad_gateway_fallback_connection.formula: count(existing_or_reversible_public_connections across or alongside the North Fifth Ring gateway with a defined fallback_action)
assumptions: No new bridge, tunnel, or road engineering is assumed.
s10_ringroad_gateway_fallback_connection.reason: Existing crossing geometry and official road engineering information are not yet registered.
s10_ringroad_gateway_fallback_connection.failure_threshold: gateway concept depends on an unapproved new bridge or tunnel
s10_ringroad_gateway_fallback_connection.target_rule: 至少一条既有或可逆公共连接，且不依赖新建未经批准的桥梁或隧道。
s10_ringroad_gateway_fallback_connection.target_basis: 北五环门户先保证可回退连接，不预设大型工程。
s10_ringroad_gateway_fallback_connection.target_verification: 道路/过街资料核验+安全审查+撤回测试。

measurement_protocol.collector: 道路/交通专业团队+北五环相关管理方
measurement_protocol.timing: 道路红线和现状过街资料确认后；施工阶段动态复核
measurement_protocol.evidence_record: gateway_audit/S10/{date}.json + crossing safety review + fallback map
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 至少一条既有或可逆公共连接，不依赖新建未批准桥隧
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 若只能依赖新工程，则取消门户承诺，退回站点/公园内部识别系统

pa_open_interface_count.formula: count(public_interfaces in P-A connecting station, industry frontage, park, or Qinghe bluegreen system)
pa_open_interface_count.reason: Prototype interface geometries are not yet digitized.
pa_open_interface_count.target_rule: P-A 至少有一个同时连接站点、产业前场、公园或清河蓝绿系统的开放接口。
pa_open_interface_count.target_basis: 原型必须先证明一个真实可进入接口，再扩展为网络。
pa_open_interface_count.target_verification: 公共进入授权+现场路径核验+蓝绿约束审查。

measurement_protocol.collector: 园区运营方+轨道管理方+公园/水务专业方
measurement_protocol.timing: P-A正式边界和公共进入条件确认后
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 至少一个接口同时触达站点、产业前场、公园或清河蓝绿系统
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 没有公共进入或约束冲突时缩小为单节点测试

pb_cross_corridor_route_count.formula: count(cross-corridor public routes in P-B connecting campus-side anchors and east-side neighborhood frontage)
assumptions: P-B is an anchor-corrected explanatory prototype.
pb_cross_corridor_route_count.reason: Cross-corridor route geometry is not yet digitized.
pb_cross_corridor_route_count.target_rule: P-B 至少两条跨廊公共路线，且至少一条不穿越受控校园内部。
pb_cross_corridor_route_count.target_basis: 跨廊道方案需要冗余和非校园单一依赖。
pb_cross_corridor_route_count.target_verification: 双锚点路径审计+权属确认+无障碍测试。

measurement_protocol.collector: 校园/社区协同方+道路交通团队+权属确认方
measurement_protocol.timing: P-B正式边界、道路和校园开放条件确认后
measurement_protocol.evidence_record: prototype_audit/P-B/{date}.json + dual-anchor route records + access permissions
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 至少两条跨廊公共路线，至少一条不穿校园内部
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 任一路线权限或无障碍失败时回退为校园外公共路段

assumptions: P-C uses an anchor-corrected conceptual geometry pending official key-area polygons.
pc_quadrant_access_coverage_ratio.reason: Quadrant boundaries, accessible paths, and heritage constraints are not yet digitized.
pc_quadrant_access_coverage_ratio.target_rule: 四个象限均达到站点或公园的无障碍公共路径覆盖，即 4/4。
pc_quadrant_access_coverage_ratio.target_basis: 大钟寺原型的空间完整性不是平均值，而是不能有缺失象限。
pc_quadrant_access_coverage_ratio.target_verification: 四象限逐项审计；任一象限失败则回退为分段路径。

measurement_protocol.collector: 交通专业团队+文保专业人员+无障碍审查员
measurement_protocol.timing: P-C正式边界、文保 polygon和站域出入口确认后
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 四个象限均有到站点或公园的无障碍公共路径，结果=4/4
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 任一象限失败即记录具体障碍，回退为可用象限分段方案

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and official site boundary are not present in the public site package.
floor_area_ratio.target_rule: 最终值不得超过 official planning_limits.json 与正式控规允许的 FAR；资料未发布前不得设定数值。
floor_area_ratio.target_basis: 开发强度是法定控制量，不由概念方案自行指定。
floor_area_ratio.target_verification: official boundary+控规批复/正式指标+专业规划复核。

measurement_protocol.collector: 规划专业团队+控规审批/复核方
measurement_protocol.timing: official boundary和正式控规发布后
measurement_protocol.evidence_record: planning_recalculation/FAR/{version}.json + official control citation + calculation sheet
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 计算值不超过 official approved FAR 上限
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 超限时不进入开发强度结论，按正式控制值重做用地和规模方案

site_area_sqm.note: provisional 边界面积，与 DATA-SRC-PROVISIONAL-BOUNDARIES-20260605 校核值一致；非 official 精确面积。

green_space_area_sqm.note: 概念设计值：由 provisional 边界派生的策略分区计算，非现状实测；official 数据发布后必须复算。

green_ratio.note: 概念设计值：由 provisional 边界派生的策略分区计算，非现状实测；official 数据发布后必须复算。

public_space_area_sqm.note: 概念设计值：由 provisional 边界内的策略分区派生，已对边界内缩 0.5m 消除投影边界微小悬空，不是现状实测；official 数据发布后必须复算。

public_space_ratio.note: 概念设计值：由 provisional 边界内的策略分区派生，已对边界内缩 0.5m 消除投影边界微小悬空，不是现状实测；official 数据发布后必须复算。

key_areas_total_area_sqm.note: provisional 重点区面积合计；公告口径约 368.4 ha。

land_use_area_lu_a_sqm.note: 概念设计值：由 provisional 边界派生的策略分区计算，非现状实测；official 数据发布后必须复算。

land_use_area_lu_b_sqm.note: 概念设计值：由 provisional 边界派生的策略分区计算，非现状实测；official 数据发布后必须复算。

land_use_area_lu_c_sqm.note: 概念设计值：由 provisional 边界派生的策略分区计算，非现状实测；official 数据发布后必须复算。

land_use_area_lu_g_sqm.note: 概念设计值：由 provisional 边界派生的策略分区计算，非现状实测；official 数据发布后必须复算。

land_use_area_lu_r_sqm.note: 概念设计值：由 provisional 边界派生的策略分区计算，非现状实测；official 数据发布后必须复算。

phasing_near_term_area_sqm.note: 概念设计值：由 provisional 边界派生的策略分区计算，非现状实测；official 数据发布后必须复算。

phasing_mid_term_area_sqm.note: 概念设计值：由 provisional 边界派生的策略分区计算，非现状实测；official 数据发布后必须复算。

phasing_long_term_area_sqm.note: 概念设计值：由 provisional 边界派生的策略分区计算，非现状实测；official 数据发布后必须复算。

total_floor_area_sqm.reason: 公开包无建筑底数与控规容积率；buildings 图层保持空集合。
total_floor_area_sqm.target_rule: 最终建筑规模不得超过 official site area × approved FAR，并须通过权属、消防和建筑底数复核。
total_floor_area_sqm.target_basis: 总量由正式边界、控规和建筑底数共同决定。
total_floor_area_sqm.target_verification: 官方边界+建筑普查/底图+控规指标复算。

measurement_protocol.collector: 规划团队+建筑普查/测绘团队+权属方
measurement_protocol.timing: official boundary、建筑底图和 approved FAR 均取得后
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 总建筑面积不超过 official site area × approved FAR，并通过权属/消防复核
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 数据不完整或超限时保持 null，撤回确定性规模表述

building_density.reason: 公开包无建筑轮廓数据，buildings 图层为空。
building_density.target_rule: 最终建筑密度不得超过正式控规或专业审查确定的上限；资料未发布前保持 null。
building_density.target_basis: 建筑覆盖率不能从空建筑图层推定。
building_density.target_verification: 建筑轮廓、权属、消防、日照和控规复核。

measurement_protocol.collector: 建筑/规划专业团队+消防/日照复核方
measurement_protocol.timing: official building footprints和控规/专业上限取得后
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 计算值不超过正式控规或专业审查上限
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 超限或约束缺失时不输出建筑密度结论，回退低扰动原则

road_area_sqm.reason: 道路红线缺失；roads 图层仅含概念中心线，无道路用地面。
road_area_sqm.target_rule: 按 official road redline 计算；概念慢行中心线不得转换为道路用地面积。
road_area_sqm.target_basis: 道路面积是法定/现状几何指标，不是概念路径缓冲面积。
road_area_sqm.target_verification: 道路红线、权属、市政和交通专业复核。

measurement_protocol.collector: 道路交通专业团队+市政部门/道路管理方
measurement_protocol.timing: official road redlines和site boundary取得后
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 只统计 official road redline 面积，不把概念中心线缓冲计入
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 红线缺失时保持 null，不输出道路用地面积

road_area_ratio.target_rule: road_area_sqm / official_site_area_sqm；两项正式几何均确认后计算。
road_area_ratio.target_basis: 分母和分子均不能使用 provisional/conceptual 替代值。

measurement_protocol.collector: 道路交通专业团队+规划复核方
measurement_protocol.pass_rule: 按 road_area_sqm / official_site_area_sqm 计算，两个输入均为 official
measurement_protocol.failure_record: 任一输入非 official 时保持 null，禁止使用 provisional 分母或概念道路面积
